name: Marketing - A/B Testing Email Subject Lines

parameters.query: INSERT INTO email_campaigns (campaign_name, campaign_type, status, subject_line, segment_criteria, client_id, stats) VALUES ('{{ $json.campaign_name }}', 'ab_test', 'active', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.variants.map(v => v.subject_line)) }}', '{{ JSON.stringify({test_id: $json.test_id, variants: $json.variants, winning_metric: $json.winning_metric, test_duration_hours: $json.test_duration_hours}) }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, '{{ JSON.stringify({test_audience: $json.test_audience, remaining: $json.remaining_audience, status: "testing"}) }}'::jsonb) RETURNING id

SELECT c.id, c.email, c.first_name FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status NOT IN ('lost') {{ $node['Setup A/B Test'].json.client_id ? 'AND c.client_id = ' + $node['Setup A/B Test'].json.client_id : '' }} ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT {{ $node['Setup A/B Test'].json.test_audience }}

INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) VALUES ({{ $json.contact_id }}, 'ab_test_email_sent', '{"test_id": "{{ $json.test_id }}", "variant_id": "{{ $json.variant_id }}", "variant_label": "{{ $json.variant_label }}"}'::jsonb, 0)

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, test_id: $node['Setup A/B Test'].json.test_id, variants: $node['Setup A/B Test'].json.variants.length, test_audience: $node['Setup A/B Test'].json.test_audience, message: 'A/B test started. Winner will be determined after ' + $node['Setup A/B Test'].json.test_duration_hours + ' hours.' }) }}
